armorColor.title: Calculate dye sequence for {type} color
armorColor.explanation.java_2x2: Colors obtainable using a 2x2 crafting grid.
armorColor.explanation.java_brown: Colors using the minimum number of brown dyes.
armorColor.explanation.java_12w34a: Java Edition versions from 12w34a (when armor dyeing was first added) to 1.4.3.
armorColor.sequence.help: If there is an arrow, place all the dyes before the arrow in the crafting grid, and dye armor using that. Then do the same up to the next arrow, dyeing the armor in multiple steps.
armorColor.sequence.helpBedrock: You should dye the armor by adding each dye in order to a cauldron and then use the armor on the cauldron.
armorColor.dE.help: Delta E is a measure of color proximity. Lower is better. Values ≤1.0 means the difference is not perceptible by human eyes.
